column4: Central Bank of Sri Lanka
register,  license,  regulate  and  supervise  financial
institutions;
resolve  financial  institutions  regulated  and
supervised by the Central Bank;
adopt  and  implement  macroprudential  policy
measures;
collect and produce statistics;
act  as  financial  advisor  and  banker  to  the
Government;
act as fiscal agent of the Government to the extent
provided for by or under any written law;
inform the Parliament, Government, and the public
about its policies and operations;
cooperate  with  and  participate  in  international
organizations,  including  public  international
financial institutions, and cooperate with domestic
and foreign public institutions, concerning matters
related to its objects;
promote financial inclusion in Sri Lanka;
establish  deposit  insurance  and  liquidity  support
schemes as means of securing the financial system
stability;
hold,  sell  and  dispose  of  property,  both  movable
and immovable, and enter into contracts;
acquire  and  hold  such  assets  and  incur  such
liabilities as it may deem necessary; and
generally,  do  all  such  acts  and  things  as  are
necessary  for,  or  incidental  or  conducive  to  the
carrying  out  or  attainment  of  the  objects  of  the
Central Bank.
